record.dic_text:
02268 Cheber {kheh'-ber}

與 02267 同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Heber 11; 11

希別, 希百, 希伯 = "忠實的同伴"
1) 基尼人, 雅億的丈夫, 將西西拉從鬢邊釘入橛子釘死
2) 亞設的後裔, 希別人的祖先
3) 梭哥之祖, 一個猶大族中的人 (#代上4:17|)
4) 一個便雅憫人 (#代上8:17|)
record.edic_text:
02268 Cheber {kheh'-ber}

the same as 02267;; n pr m

AV - Heber 11; 11

Heber = "comrade"
1) the Kenite, husband of Jael, who slew Sisera by driving a nail
   into his temple
2) grandson of Asher from whom came the Heberites
3) father of Socho, a Judahite
4) a Benjamite
5) another Benjamite
6) a Gadite
